source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > EMCA Settings > — EMCA Logging Support = Enable — EMCA CMCI-SMI Morphing = EMCA gen2 CSMI — EMCA CMCI-SMI Threshold = 0 — EMCA MCA-SMI Enable = EMCA gen 2 - MSMI EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > IIO Error Enabling > OS Native AER Support = Enable 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into Windows. 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 5. Ensure the corresponding PCIe status registers are cleared and the link status is performing at the expected speed. >>> halt() >>> sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.devsts 0x0 >>> sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.erruncsts 0x0 >>> sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.linksts.show 6. Check on severity level of completion timeout and verify mask is cleared for a completion timeout. In this example, the CTO set is operating to non-fatal severity with CTES=0. >>> sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.erruncmsk.show() 7. Confirm that DPC is enabled and the uncorrectable error mask is cleared for a completion timeout. DPCTE will likely not match what is defined in the BIOS as a result of operating in OS Native mode. >>>>>> sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.dpcctl.show 8. Check PCIe slot target 9. Inject PCIe completion timeout error using the CScripts. >>>ei.injectPcieError(socket, port, errType='uce') 10. Check the DPC and link status registers and confirm the correct field is triggered. DPCTS is expected to be set to 1 since DPC triggered as a result of the CTO that can be seen in the ERRUNCSTS where the CTE field is set. Device status shows that a non-fatal error was logged, as expected. The system should still be halted and as a result of DPC triggering, SUT should be operating in a down state. This is demonstrated as the DLLA field is cleared, and the CLS shows the platform is operating at Gen 1 speed. >>>sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.devsts.show >>>sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.erruncsts.show >>>sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.dpcsts.show >>>sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.linksts.show 11. Go/release the system, all status registers listed previously should automatically clear, and there should be no need to manually clear these registers. Confirm link is back up and returned to original speed - link should train automatically. DEVSTS and ERRUNCSTS are cleared. DPCTS is also now cleared as the system has been released, and LINKSTS shows the link is back up and operating at Gen 4 speeds. >>>go >>> sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.devsts 0x0 >>> sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.erruncsts 0x0 >>> sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.linksts.show >>> sv.socket1.uncore.pi5.pxp0.pcieg5.port2.cfg.dpcsts.show 12 Evaluate the OS Error Logs and confirm the PCIe error logs are captured/reported. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

ITP/CScripts build/hash and exact completion-timeout selector behind `errType='uce'`
EMCA/OS Native AER/DPC ownership, CT severity/mask and DPC-enable definitions
Per-link original speed/width and expected CTE/DPCTS/DLLA/clear/retrain oracle
Endpoint quiesce, abort, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration plan
